paragraphs: Mentioned in Berakhot 53b: he posed a difficulty to Mar Zutra.[^1][^2]

notes.text: נג: is rendered Berakhot 53b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification.
Hyman says Yeimar posed a difficulty to Mar Zutra, without giving its content. Rav and Mar are both explicit full titles.
